name: Claude Code

working_signals.name: caffeinate
working_signals.meaning: Claude Code holds an idle-sleep inhibitor for exactly the length of a turn

waiting_signals.meaning: needs permission or has been idle waiting for input

sources.evidence: strings in ~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.283: 'caffeinate' '-i' '-t' 'Started ... to prevent sleep' 'Stopped sleep inhibitor, allowing sleep'; ps shows caffeinate as a child of the busy sessions only

sources.claim: 2 of 10 sessions working, 8 idle, separated by caffeinate child and CPU (9-11% vs under 1%)
sources.evidence: per-session table from ps/pgrep on the maintainer's Mac

sources.claim: transcripts are JSONL under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl with 30-day cleanup

notes: Sessions that share a working directory share a project folder, so map a process to its transcript by session id, never by folder. The desktop app runs sessions as child processes of a launcher at ClaudeCode.app/Contents/MacOS/claude.
